name: protege
description: AI coding mentor that lives in your editor

protege.backendUrl.description: Backend URL for the Protege API. Leave empty to use the shipped default. Set to your own deployment (e.g. https://your-protege-backend.up.railway.app) to self-host. The PROTEGE_BACKEND_URL environment variable overrides this. Reload the window after changing.

protege.autoAcceptEdits.description: When true, AI-proposed edits from chat are applied without a confirmation dialog. When false (recommended), every edit shows a preview diff and requires explicit acceptance.

protege.learning.devLogging.description: Capture full Learning Mode session traces — raw plan JSON, every validator verdict, hint/show reveals. Dumps to the Protege Output channel and enables the Dev drawer in the Learning panel. Use `Protege: Learning — export last session trace` to save to disk. Turn off before external release to keep sessions summary-only.

protege.explainMode.description: How Protege delivers the Ghost Lens "Explain" action. `text` (default) opens the sidebar with a chat reply. `voice` speaks a short explanation through Kokoro TTS while your eyes stay on the code. `both` does both at once. Modifier keys still override per-click: hold ⌘ to force voice, ⇧ to force text.

protege.voice.gender.description: Which Kokoro voice Protege speaks with. `female` (af_bella, default) is warmer; `male` (am_michael) is lower-pitched. Applies to all TTS — voice mode replies, Ghost Lens "Explain", teaching narrations.

protege.ownership.invitations.description: When Protege nudges you to review auto-inserted (vibecoded) code. `natural-breaks` (default) shows a small status-bar chip at most once per break type per day. `aggressive` drops the per-day dedupe (useful while tuning). `off` disables all ownership nudges.

protege.ownership.autoTrackingEnabled.description: Track which lines of each file you typed vs. auto-inserted from AI tools. Required for the ownership score + vibecode-review invitations. Turn off to fully disable Protege's ownership tracking (your typed code is never sent to any server — this is all local).

protege.selectionHover.enabled.description: When true, highlighting code auto-opens a small Protege action popup (Explain · Teach me · Explain back) at the selection. The ⌘K S shortcut still works even when this is off, for keyboard-first users who don't want the auto-popup.

protege.predict.enabled.description: Predict-and-Reveal: when you hit ⌘K P on a line or selection, Protege asks you to predict what the code does for a specific input, then reveals the answer with a one-line reason. The 'feels like learning' loop — enabled by default.

protege.misconceptions.enabled.description: Misconception Catcher: when you accept vibecoded code, Protege scans it against a rule library for specific wrong mental models (await in .map, JSON.parse+stringify cloning, .sort mutation, etc.) and flags matches with a subtle amber line-border + hover. Pull-based — the hover only opens when you mouse over.

protege.learning.enabled.description: Learning Mode: ⌘K L prompts for a goal, then Protege generates a 3–5 step plan and you build each step. ⌘↵ marks done, validator checks, moves to next. Instead of Protege writing code for you, it coaches you through writing it yourself.

protege.aiBlocks.enabled.description: AI Block Highlighter: every auto-inserted (vibecoded) region gets a subtle blue line-wash + a CodeLens '◎ <summary> · ✿ Teach me this block'. Click to open a rich hover with a short What + a One thing to know + Got it / Tell me more / Dismiss. Replaces the old comment-thread briefing with a browsable ambient artifact — review whenever you want.

protege.autoBudgetPerHour.description: Hourly cap on AUTO-FIRED cloud LLM calls (file-open greeter, vibe brief, struggle chip — anything that fires without you clicking). User-triggered actions (chat, ⌘K P, Learning Mode, voice Explain) bypass this cap. In `auto` backend mode these route on-device first, so this only kicks in when you've explicitly picked a cloud backend like Haiku. Set to 0 to disable all auto-fired cloud calls; raise it if you want a chattier hint surface.

protege.codeReview.liveReview.description: Live Review — analyze code as you type, surface defect findings as blue underlines and lens hints. Master switch for the Code Review group; turning it off silences findings without disabling other categories.

protege.codeReview.smartFix.description: Smart Fix — one-click bug repairs offered next to detected defects.

protege.codeReview.errorLineHighlight.description: Error-line highlight — subtle line tint on rows containing diagnostics so they read at a glance.

protege.codeReview.underlineWhispers.description: Underline whispers — soft inline annotations that elaborate on diagnostic squiggles without opening a panel.

protege.codeReview.statusBar.description: Status bar summary — live counter in the status bar showing finding totals and IQ deltas.

protege.teaching.didYouKnow.description: Did You Know? — proactive teaching tips above lines containing concepts you have not seen before. Triggers at natural pauses (idle, file switch, save). Tip text is pulled from a shared cache so the LLM call happens once per concept across all users.

protege.teaching.patternSpotter.description: Pattern spotter — RETIRED. The proactive idle-time popup was removed 2026-04-30. Setting kept for backwards compatibility; flipping it to true currently has no effect.

protege.teaching.ghostMentor.description: Ghost mentor — proactive coaching messages that surface as you work. Off by default; some users find it chatty.

protege.teaching.struggleChip.description: Struggle chip — surfaces a hover signal when Protege detects you are stuck on the same area for a while. Experimental.

protege.aiHighlights.chatHighlights.description: Chat-driven highlights — lens decorations painted by AI tool calls during a chat session, with Apply fix / Teach me / Dismiss actions.

protege.recap.saveRecap.description: Save recap — brief toast after a meaningful save summarising what changed and what you learned.

protege.recap.conceptTrail.description: Concept trail — strip showing concepts you touched today, useful for spotting your daily learning surface.

protege.recap.projectMap.description: Project map — architecture overview view with file groupings and dependency hints.
